subject: Hosted API commit uplift, tier rebanding, and invoice timing
messages:
From: Sam Wilkes <sam@bluepeak.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@bluepeak.ai>
Date: 2028-07-25T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted commit increase and rate-tier question

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the catch-up yesterday. BluePeak is seeing higher-than-expected traction on the conversational product — Q2 token usage was ~2.8x what we forecasted. We want to avoid throttles or unpredictable overage fees for the fall launch.

Request: can we move from our current hosted commit of 3M tokens/month to a 7M tokens/month committed tier starting Aug 1, with a 10% discount on unit rates for the additional volume band? We also need the burst window increased to 20% of committed for occasional spikes.

Operational asks:
- Confirmation of new effective date and invoice timing (we prefer monthly billing).
- Any lead time you need for provisioning or routing to Dedicated during spikes.
- Updated SOW and DocuSign if terms are approved.

I attached the Q2 usage export for reference.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Wilkes
Head of Product
BluePeak Labs
Attachments: BluePeak_usage_Q2.csv
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wilkes <sam@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-26T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit increase and rate-tier question

Sam —

Really good to see the traction, congrats to the team. We can absolutely support a 7M/month committed pathway with a burst band; below is a sketch of the proposal so we can align internally and confirm pricing.

Proposal (high-level) — effective Aug 1 if we sign by end of week:
- Base commit: 7,000,000 tokens/month (12-month term).
- Unit pricing: Current base unit rate for first 3M remains; additional 4M at a proposed 10% discount on the incremental unit rate (we'll include per-token numbers in the SOW).
- Burst window: 20% of commit (allowed to consume up to 8.4M tokens in a heavy month before overage). Overage rate will be the incremental band rate + 25% premium.
- SLA and routing: No Dedicated migration required initially — auto-fallback routing and soft-throttle will be configured. If you opt into Dedicated capacity later, we can define a migration window but it is not required for Aug 1.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal pricing and legal check (cc'd) — Karithik can validate the margin/ops impact and Marissa will scope onboarding and SLO adjustments.
2) I’ll send an updated SOW + DocuSign link once legal confirms the incremental unit price.
3) You confirm billing preference (monthly) and PO or billing contact for invoice routing.

I attached a short redline-ready SOW template to speed sign-off.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachments: BluePeak_SOW_v2.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-27T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit increase and rate-tier question

Tessa / Marissa —

Reviewed the ask and Q2 usage file. Quick notes from infra/ops POV:
- 7M/month commit looks fine from a capacity standpoint; we can handle that on hosted lanes with no Dedicated commitment now.
- Burst of 20% is operationally safe, but we should add a short (72-hour) cooling policy for repeated monthly bursts to avoid cache churn and latency degradations.
- Recommend we include a recommended batching/kv-cache guide in onboarding so BluePeak preserves latency SLOs at higher volume.

Pricing considerations:
- I'm okay with a 10% discount on incremental band but would like to retain standard incremental overage premium at +25%. If Finance wants to be more aggressive we can adjust delta, but prefer to keep some guardrail.

I'll work with Marissa on an ops checklist and an onboarding runbook (1-week plan) that we can include in the SOW.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wilkes <sam@bluepeak.ai>, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit increase and rate-tier question

Sam —

Thanks for the heads-up. We’ve drafted the onboarding checklist and a short latency-preservation guide (includes KV cache recommendations, suggested batching window, and a verification script for peak window tests). If you sign by COB Friday we can schedule a one-week onboarding sprint starting Aug 5 to configure soft-throttle thresholds and test monthly burst behavior.

Billing/PO: Please route invoices to finance@bluepeak.ai and include the PO reference BP-INV-2028-07 in the invoice. We will issue monthly invoices on the 1st of each month.

Attached: SOW (redlined) and onboarding checklist. I’ll circulate the DocuSign link once legal finalizes pricing numbers (Karthik flagged the incremental premium; finance team on our side is ready at the proposed structure).

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: BluePeak_DocuSign_Agreement.pdf
From: Sam Wilkes <sam@bluepeak.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@bluepeak.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted commit increase and rate-tier question

Marissa / Tessa —

This looks good to us. BluePeak confirms: start date Aug 1; monthly invoices to finance@bluepeak.ai with PO BP-INV-2028-07. We accept the 10% incremental discount band and the +25% overage premium.

Please send the DocuSign and final SOW and we’ll process the PO.

Appreciate the quick turn.

—Sam
Sam Wilkes
Head of Product | BluePeak Labs
